en.title: Minimum Plus Maximum of a Subarray
en.description:
Given an array of positive integers, choose a contiguous subarray of length at least 2 that maximizes the sum of its minimum and its maximum. Output this maximum sum.

The input format, examples, and test data are compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (2..100000); the second line contains n positive integers (1..10⁹).
en.output: Output the answer as described; multiple results are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: The example inputs and outputs follow the rules above directly; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: You only need to enumerate each pair of adjacent elements and take the maximum of their sums.
